response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT ra.name, SUM(r.points) AS tp, AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) AS al FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId GROUP BY ra.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(tp) AS m FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.tp) AS total_points, AVG(t.al) AS avg_laps, AVG(t.tp - a.m) AS avg_excess FROM t CROSS JOIN a WHERE t.tp > a.m

assumptions.assumption: The 'average laps for the kept race names' is the average of the per-race-name average laps (each kept race name weighted equally), following the per-name aggregation described in the request.

results.laps is stored as TEXT, so it is cast to REAL before averaging. NULL values are ignored by SUM and AVG. Race names with no non-null points have a NULL total and are left out of the average of totals.
Races are grouped by races.name across all years, so one race name combines all of its seasons.

alternatives.interpretation: The average laps is taken over all individual result rows belonging to the kept race names, rather than as an average of per-name averages.
alternatives.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT ra.name, SUM(r.points) AS tp FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId GROUP BY ra.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(tp) AS m FROM t), k AS (SELECT t.name, t.tp, a.m FROM t CROSS JOIN a WHERE t.tp > a.m) SELECT (SELECT SUM(tp) FROM k) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.name IN (SELECT name FROM k)) AS avg_laps, (SELECT AVG(tp - m) FROM k) AS avg_excess
